description: Golden retrieval set for the Northwind Labs synthetic knowledge base. Each question has a known correct source. Use to measure retrieval recall (did the system retrieve the expected section?) and citation correctness (did the answer cite it?).

questions.question: How many PTO days does a new hire get per year?
questions.answer: 18 days per calendar year (accrued at 1.5 days per month).

questions.question: How many unused PTO days can I carry into next year?
questions.answer: Up to 5 days; anything beyond 5 is forfeited on December 31.

questions.question: When can a new employee start working remotely?
Do I need a doctor's note if I'm out sick for two days?
questions.answer: No. A medical note is only required for absences longer than 3 consecutive working days.

questions.question: Can I fly business class on a 9-hour flight?
questions.answer: Premium economy is permitted for flights of 6+ hours; business class requires VP approval regardless of length.

questions.question: What's the limit on a client dinner, and how much can be alcohol?
questions.answer: Up to $150 per attendee, of which at most $50 per attendee may be alcohol.

questions.question: How long do I have to submit an expense report?
questions.answer: Within 30 days of the expense date.

questions.question: Can I paste customer Confidential data into an AI assistant?
questions.answer: No. Confidential or Restricted data must not be pasted into third-party AI tools.

questions.question: How quickly must a suspected security incident be reported?
questions.answer: Within 1 hour of discovery, to the security team.

questions.question: What must a new hire do on Day 1?
questions.answer: Complete identity verification, sign the Acceptable Use Policy, and enable MFA on all assigned accounts.

questions.question: How long are application logs kept?
How fast must we fulfill a customer deletion request?
Does an $8,000/year vendor need a security review before signing?
questions.answer: Not by the value threshold ($8k is under $10k, so manager approval), but a security review is still required if the vendor handles Confidential or Restricted data.
